pages.title: Implementation
pages.purpose: Source-grounded walkthrough of files-to-prompt internals: input traversal (os.walk, sorted files), hidden-file and .gitignore/ignore-pattern handling, the three formatters (default, Claude XML, Markdown fence escaping), UnicodeDecodeError handling, plus a focused maintenance guide grounded in the pytest suite. 400-600 words per the pilot brief.
instructions: Cite concrete source evidence (repo:// spans in files_to_prompt/cli.py and tests/test_files_to_prompt.py) for non-obvious claims; state uncertainty when evidence is absent
Cover error handling: UnicodeDecodeError warning to stderr with exit 0 (test_binary_file_warning), BadArgumentUsage for nonexistent stdin paths
Cover formatting: print_default, print_as_xml with global_index, print_as_markdown backtick fence extension and EXT_TO_LANG, add_line_numbers padding

Cover: input traversal via os.walk with sorted(files) per directory (cli.py process_path), hidden file/dir filtering, .gitignore rule accumulation (read_gitignore, should_ignore, basename matching, directory trailing-slash rule), --ignore patterns and --ignore-files-only
Maintenance guide: pytest suite via CliRunner, pip install -e '.[test]', CI matrix Python 3.9-3.13, global_index reset noted in code comment
